name: MenuGate Rules
author: mh Arif

sections.description:
MenuGate Rules allows you to show or hide individual WordPress menu items based on user login status and device type.
It works with any properly coded theme and does not rely on external services.

Features

  • Show menu items for logged-in users
  • Show menu items for logged-out users
  • Device-based visibility (desktop or mobile)
  • Lightweight and theme-independent
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Appearance → Menus
  4. Configure visibility rules per menu item
sections.faq:
Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all properly coded WordPress themes.
